Screens

Every LN screen the tasks open, by name. One the library has not described yet says so.

  • Activities by Procedure

    whinh0106m000 Sets which activities a warehousing procedure has, and which of them run automatically.

  • Activities by Warehousing Order

    whinh2104m000 Sets which warehousing procedure activities apply to one order — the only place that can be changed for an individual order.

  • Alternative Items

    tcibd0505m000 Lists the items that may stand in for an item.

  • Approve Adjustment Order Variances

    whinh5821m000 Approves adjustment-order lines that require approval — the second stage, not the booking.

  • Business Partners

    tccom4500m000 Lists the business partners, each with its role, status and main address.

  • Buy-from Business Partner

    tccom4120s000 The details screen where one buy-from business partner is entered or maintained.

  • Buy-from Business Partners

    tccom4520m000 Lists buy-from business partners and their status, for viewing rather than editing.

  • Calculate Estimated End Item Unit Costs

    ticst0210m000 Calculates the estimated unit cost of an end item.

  • Check Horizons

    cprpd1200m000 Calculates a plan item's cumulative order lead time, and checks and brings into line the order horizons of the items in a bill of material.

  • Close Production Orders

    ticst0201m000 Settles the financial side of a production order once its goods are already in inventory.

  • Companies

    tcemm1170m000 Holds each company's own settings, among them its calendar and its currency system.

  • Company - Item Inventory

    whwmd4100m100 Lists every item with its inventory across the company, on hand, blocked, on order and allocated.

  • Concept Activation

    tcemm4600m000 Shows and maintains the activation status of one LN concept, chosen upstream.

  • Confirm Order Planning

    cprrp1200m000 Confirms a range of planned orders in one run, and can take only those inside their order lead time.

  • Cost Calculation Codes

    ticpr1100m000 Lists and maintains named cost-calculation recipes that other sessions reference by code.

  • Customer 360

    tdsmi1500m000 A dashboard of one customer, with links into the data kept about it.

  • Dataset Filter

    ttadv9140m000 Holds the conditions one table of a dataset is filtered by, and marks which of them become prompt parameters.

  • Dataset Output Formats

    ttrpi5110m000 Registers the formats a dataset's output can be written in before it is put into a GenAI prompt.

  • Dataset Parameters

    ttrpi5501m000 Lists the parameters LN generated for one dataset, each a selection range or a query filter.

  • Datasets

    ttrpi5100m000 Lists the datasets, the modelled extracts of LN data a GenAI prompt can send with its question.

  • Default Order Types by Origin

    whinh0120m000 Links a warehousing order type to an order origin, so orders generated from that origin default to that type and its procedure.

  • Delete Item Data

    tcibd0206m000 Deletes a range of items or item groups, together with the data that hangs on them.

  • Delivery Notes

    whinh4135m000 Lists the delivery notes LN makes for shipments, the paper that travels with the goods.

  • Departments

    tcmcs0565m000 Defines departments. A work center needs one first, and its calendar can be set here.

  • Estimated Materials

    ticst0101m000 The materials a production order is expected to use and the warehouse each is allocated from. It locks once the estimated costs are frozen.

  • GenAI LLM Versions

    ttrpi5561m000 Lists the versions of one language model, and which version the Infor GenAI service treats as default.

  • GenAI LLMs

    ttrpi5560m000 Lists the language models the Infor GenAI service offers LN, and which one is the default.

  • GenAI Prompt Parameters

    ttrpi5151m000 Lists the inputs one GenAI prompt takes, copied from the dataset linked to it.

  • GenAI Prompts

    ttrpi5150m000 Defines each GenAI prompt, the text sent to the Infor GenAI service, the LN data sent with it, and the model that answers.

  • GenAI Prompts by Session

    ttadv9160m000 Links a GenAI prompt to a session, which is what puts the prompt on that screen as a command.

  • General Projects

    tcmcs0152s000 Records a general project as a code; the plan itself lives in whichever package claims it.

  • Generate Inbound Advice

    whinh3201m000 The activity that generates inbound advice for received goods. It is not available in a warehouse without locations.

  • Generate Order Planning

    cprrp1210m000 Runs the range-based order-planning process that turns demand into planned orders.

  • Generate Order Planning (Item)

    cprrp1220m000 Runs order planning for a single item.

  • Generate Pegging Relations

    cprrp0240m000 Runs the generation of pegging relations, in full or as a net-change update.

  • Global Update of Item with Defaults

    tdisa0202m000 Assigns new default values to sales items in bulk.

  • Harmonized System Codes

    tcmcs0128m000 Holds the harmonized system codes that items are reported under on the Intrastat declaration.

  • Implemented Software Components

    tccom0500m000 Records which LN concepts and modules are switched on for this company.

  • Initiate Inventory Issue

    tisfc0207m000 Issues material from inventory to a production order, activating the corresponding warehouse order line.

  • Inventory 360

    whwmd4300m000 The starting point for any question about where an item's stock is and what state it is in.

  • Inventory 360 - Graphical View

    whwmd4300m200 Inventory 360 with a graph and four exception tiles, which count the items heading for trouble and filter the list to them.

  • Inventory by Production Order

    tisfc0516m000 The inventory part of one production order, shown inside the order itself.

  • Inventory Consumptions

    tdsls4140m000 Holds what was received, consumed and invoiced of stock that is kept at the customer's site.

  • Inventory Handling Parameters

    whinh0100m000 Company-wide picking and shipping parameters, held as a dated history with one current set.

  • Item

    tcibd0501m100 Specifies and maintains one item's global data across its subentities.

  • Item - Costing

    ticpr0107m000 Maintains an item's cost data, within whatever the cost calculation parameters permit.

  • Item - Ordering

    tcibd2600m000 The global item ordering record — lot-size limits, intervals and safety settings that the site and warehouse levels inherit from.

  • Item - Ordering by Site

    tcibd2150m000 Holds an item's ordering data for one site, where a site departs from the company's defaults.

  • Item - Ordering Defaults

    tcibd2101m000 Holds the default ordering data for an item type and item group combination.

  • Item - Production Defaults

    tiipd0102m100 Holds the default production data for an item type and item group combination.

  • Item - Production Defaults by Site

    tiipd0152m000 The site-level counterpart of Item - Production Defaults, including backflushing and material-issue defaults.

  • Item - Purchase

    tdipu0601m000 The global purchase data for one item, holding what is needed to buy it at all.

  • Item - Sales

    tdisa0601m000 One item's sales data.

  • Item - Sales Defaults

    tdisa0102s000 Holds the default sales data for an item type and item group combination.

  • Item - Warehousing

    whwmd4600m000 The warehousing detail behind one item — location control, inventory-variance handling, and supply settings.

  • Item - Warehousing Defaults

    whwmd4101s000 Holds the default warehousing data — lot, serial, ownership and cross-docking behaviour — for an item type and item group combination.

  • Item Code Segmentation

    tcibd0500m000 Defines the segments an item code is made of.

  • Item Code Systems

    tcibd0106m000 Defines the outside numbering schemes, such as a customer's or a manufacturer's part numbers, that an item can also be known by.

  • Item Control and Defaults by Site

    tcibd1552m000 Decides, per site, which per-module item records are generated for a new item.

  • Item Defaults

    tcibd0102m000 The default data template applied when a new item is created.

  • Item Defaults

    tcibd0502m000 The detail form behind Item Defaults, holding the default item data for one item type and item group combination.

  • Item Defaults by Site

    tcibd1551m000 The site-level counterpart of Item Defaults, holding default item data for a site, item type and item group combination.

  • Item Engineering Revisions

    tcibd0150m000 Holds the revisions of an engineering item, where engineering revisions are switched on.

  • Item Groups

    tcmcs0123m000 Defines the item group half of the key — together with item type — that the item defaults chain is keyed on.

  • Item Order Plan

    cprrp0520m000 A time-phased view of one item's order planning: demand and forecast against scheduled receipts and planned supply.

  • Item Order Plan - Find

    cprrp0521s000 The search box that picks which item's order plan to open.

  • Item Purchase Defaults by Site

    tdipu0182m000 The default purchase data that items take at one site.

  • Item Signals

    tcmcs0118m000 Defines item signals, each of which blocks an item or warns about it in the areas it is set for.

  • Item Standard Costs

    ticpr3501m000 Displays an item's actual and historical standard cost structures by date — read-only history.

  • Item, Lot and Serial 360

    whltc3600m100 Shows the transactions of one item, lot or serial number, and draws what a lot or serialized item was built from.

  • Items

    tcibd0501m000 Maintains global item data at the company level — the centrally controlled item record and its subentities.

  • Items - Ordering

    tcibd2100m000 Governs supply-planning boundaries, lot sizing and ordering intervals — how much LN plans and in how many orders.

  • Items - Planning

    cprpd1100m000 Holds the order horizon, planning horizon and time fence that decide whether and how far ahead an item is planned.

  • Items - Purchase

    tdipu0101m000 Lists the purchase data of items, the overview that one item's purchase detail opens from.

  • Items - Purchase Defaults

    tdipu0102m000 Holds the default purchasing data — buy-from partner, unit, currency, receipt tolerances — for a new purchased item.

  • Items - Sales

    tdisa0501m000 Holds one item's sales data, including whether its order lines are released to warehousing.

  • Items - Sales Business Partner

    tdisa0510m000 Holds sales data for one item and one business partner together, with the dates it applies from and to.

  • Items by Alternative Item

    tcibd0505m100 Lists the items a given alternative can stand in for, the same link read from the other side.

  • Items by Site

    tcibd1550m000 Holds the per-site row for an item under multisite, where site data can mirror or diverge from the global item.

  • Job Shop Bill of Material

    tibom3600m000 The single-BOM detail view behind Job Shop Bills of Material.

  • Job Shop Bills of Material

    tibom3100m000 Manages bill-of-material header data for multi-site BOMs used in job shop production.

  • Job Shop List of Materials

    tibom3110m000 Specifies the materials and quantities required to manufacture a product — a BOM's material lines.

  • Job Shop Master Data Parameters

    tirou0100m000 The parameter set that controls how routings, operations and work centres behave in job shop production.

  • Job Shop Routing

    tirou4600m000 Manages routings by revision and site, displaying the data listed in Job Shop Routings.

  • Job Shop Routings

    tirou4100m000 Lists job shop routing operations.

  • List Components

    tcibd3100m000 Holds what is inside a list item, a set of components sold or bought together, by list group.

  • List Groups

    tcibd3101m000 Defines list groups, which keep lists for different uses apart, such as sales lists and purchase lists.

  • Manufacturers

    tcmcs0160m000 Defines manufacturers, to group items by who makes them or to buy one item from alternative makers.

  • Mask by Item/Item Group/Site

    tcibd4505m100 Links a mask to an item, an item group or a site, so its serial numbers and lot codes are generated from it.

  • Mask Segments

    tcibd4503m000 Lists the segments a mask is built from.

  • Masks

    tcibd4102m000 Defines a mask, the template LN builds a serial number or a lot code from.

  • Mass Change Item Assignments

    tcibd0204m000 Reassigns the buyer, planner, shop floor planner or routing group of many items in one run.

  • Material to Issue for Production Orders

    ticst0101m100 Shows and maintains the material quantities that must be issued from the warehouse to the production centre.

  • Order Pegging

    cprrp0740m200 Shows the pegging relations between orders as a tree, one branch for each order.

  • Outbound Line Status Overview

    whinh2129m000 Shows, for one outbound order line, which procedure activities will run and the quantity progression they produce.

  • Outbound Order Lines

    whinh2120m000 Releases outbound advice for individual order lines.

  • Picking List

    whinh4525m100 Confirms an advised quantity as picked, where picking is an activity in the warehousing procedure.

  • Planned Inventory Transactions - Graphical View

    whinp1300m000 One item's planned receipts and issues as a graph, with tiles for what is on hand, overdue, and due in or out today.

  • Planned Order

    cprrp1600m000 One planned order in detail: its order lines, which can be changed here, and the demand each was generated for.

  • Planned Orders

    cprrp1100m000 Lists the planned orders MRP produced, for review and selection before they are transferred to execution.

  • Planning Parameters

    cprpd0100m000 Company-wide planning settings, among them the CTP check for sales, the pegging horizon and how many plan revisions are kept.

  • Price Book

    tdpcg0611m000 Shows one price book and its effective records.

  • Print Menu Structure

    ttadv3475m000 Prints the menu tree, which is where the route to a screen can be looked up.

  • Process Invoices

    whinh4279m100 Creates the definitive invoice for confirmed shipments.

  • Process Pro Forma Invoices

    whinh4279m000 Creates pro forma invoices for frozen or confirmed shipments, to review before invoicing.

  • Procurement User Profiles

    tdpur0143m000 Holds each logon code's procurement defaults, among them the purchase office, site, warehouse and purchase order type its orders start from.

  • Product Classes

    tcmcs0162m000 Defines product classes, one of the codes items are classified by.

  • Product Engineering Parameters

    timfc0100m000 Parameters for product engineering, among them whether change notes are active.

  • Product Groups

    tcmcs0125m000 Defines product groups, a classification code that is kept per site.

  • Product Lines

    tcmcs0161m000 Defines product lines, one of the codes items are classified by.

  • Product Serial Numbers

    tcibd4101m000 Lists and maintains the serial numbers of products, tools, equipment, service items and generic items.

  • Product Types

    tcmcs0115m000 Defines product types, one of the codes items are classified by.

  • Production Order

    tisfc0101m100 Views and maintains one production order, covering both its materials and its operations.

  • Production Order Distribution

    tisfc0105m000 How a production order's quantity is distributed, which can give more than one production warehouse order.

  • Production Order Parameters

    tisfc0100s000 The parameter set governing Job Shop Control — where material is issued from, printing requirements, and shortage checks at release.

  • Production Order Parameters

    tisfc0500m000 Lists the dated sets of job shop control parameters; the settings themselves are inside each set.

  • Production Orders

    tisfc0501m000 An overview of production orders — identity, item, dates, status, warehouse and key quantities.

  • Production Planning

    tisfc0110m000 Shows a production order's operations, where an operation's dates, its next operation and task, and its scrap or yield are changed, and count points are marked.

  • Production Warehouse Orders

    timfc0101m000 Lists the warehouse orders of one production order, to issue, return or cancel material in detail.

  • Purchase Order

    tdpur4100m900 Enters, maintains and processes one purchase order and its lines on a single screen.

  • Purchase Order - Lines to be Released

    tdpur4501m140 A purchase order's lines that are waiting to be released to warehousing.

  • Purchase Order Intake Workbench

    tdpur4601m200 A dashboard of purchase-order activity awaiting attention.

  • Purchase Order Line Status

    tdpur4534m000 Shows which activity a purchase order line is waiting on.

  • Purchase Order Lines

    tdpur4101m000 One purchase order line in detail, including the warehouse it is received into.

  • Purchase Order Type

    tdpur0694m000 Holds one purchase order type's controls, number series, warehousing order type and the activities its orders run.

  • Purchase Order Types

    tdpur0194m000 Lists the purchase order types, each with the kind of order it makes and the warehousing order type it hands on.

  • Purchase Receipts

    tdpur4106m000 The receipts booked against a purchase order. Receipts for a direct delivery are entered here by hand.

  • Receipt Message Log

    whinh3530m000 Logs the error and information messages raised by actions on a receipt line, kept readable after the dialog is dismissed.

  • Reference Operations

    tirou4150m000 A read-only view of reusable operation templates — work centre, machine type, and standard times — that routings point to instead of retyping.

  • Release Production Orders

    tisfc0204m000 Releases production orders to the job shop, so material can be issued and hours accounted.

  • Release Sales Order Lines to Warehousing

    tdsls4501m140 The entry point for releasing a sales order line to Warehousing; the release itself runs from a menu action here.

  • Release Sales Orders to Warehousing

    tdsls4246m000 Releases a range of sales order lines to Warehousing, turning them into warehousing orders.

  • Release Sales Orders/Schedules to Invoicing

    tdsls4247m000 Releases delivered sales orders and schedules to invoicing.

  • Rental Serial Numbers

    tcibd4101m100 Shows the serial numbers LN creates for rental products, which cannot be edited.

  • Report Operations Completed

    tisfc0130m000 Reports quantities completed or rejected for successive operations on a production order.

  • Report Orders Completed

    tisfc0120s000 An order-level view of production orders that must be, or have been, reported complete.

  • Routing Groups

    tcmcs1145m000 Defines routing groups, which job shop control uses to manage workload.

  • Routing Operations

    tirou1102m000 Maintains operation data by item and routing — the individual steps a routing carries out in succession.

  • Sales Order

    tdsls4100m900 The sales order itself, header and lines, opened from the intake workbench.

  • Sales Order Fulfillment Workbench

    tdsls4601m100 A work queue of sales order lines still to deliver, the ones nearly due and the ones already late.

  • Sales Order Intake Workbench

    tdsls4601m200 A dashboard of sales-order activity awaiting attention.

  • Sales Order Invoice Lines

    tdsls4106m100 Holds a sales order's invoice lines, which exist once a delivery is made, and releases them to invoicing.

  • Sales Order Line Status

    tdsls4534s000 Lists a sales order line's activities and the next order step that must be performed.

  • Sales Order Lines

    tdsls4101m000 The lines of a sales order, with each line's warehouse, dates and inventory figures.

  • Sales Order Lines - Components

    tdsls4601m000 Holds the component lines linked to one sales order line.

  • Sales Orders

    tdsls4100m000 The sales order header, as a list of orders and as the details of one, with the defaults a header hands to its lines.

  • Sales Orders Intake (Personalization)

    tdsls4100m100 The editor that chooses which columns the sales order intake list shows.

  • Scenarios

    cprpd4100m000 Defines the scenario a planning run executes in — the horizon, whether the plan rolls, and whether the run is a net change or a full regeneration.

  • Selection Codes

    tcmcs0122m000 Defines selection codes, one of the codes items are classified by.

  • Serial End Item - As-Built Headers

    timfc0110m000 Lists a production order's end items one serial number to a line, each with a status that follows it from made to received.

  • Shipment

    whinh4630m000 Views and maintains shipments — where a shipment is frozen and confirmed and inventory finally leaves.

  • Shipment Execution Workbench

    whinh8361m000 Runs a shipment's outbound steps from one screen, from generating advice to confirming.

  • Shipment Lines

    whinh4131m000 The only place a shipped quantity can be changed, before the shipment line is confirmed.

  • Shipment Planning Workbench

    whinh8370m000 Plans a week of shipments by turning outbound order lines into projected shipments before anything is picked.

  • Shipment Workbench

    whinh8360m000 Lists the shipments waiting at a warehouse's staging area or docks, to freeze, confirm or reopen them from one place.

  • Shipments

    whinh4130m000 Views, maintains and confirms shipments.

  • Sourcing Strategy

    cprpd7110m000 Says how an item's demand is split over making, buying and distributing, and it wins over the item's own default supply source.

  • Standard Cost Calculation Parameters

    ticpr0100m000 The module-level switches that decide what a standard cost calculation is allowed to do.

  • Statistical Groups

    tcmcs0144m000 Defines statistical groups, one of the codes items are classified by.

  • Stock Point Blocking

    whwmd6130m000 Blocks one stock point, in full or for a quantity, so that the stock is held and not issued.

  • Transfer Order Planning

    cppat1210m000 Converts a planned order into a real order in its owning module — production, purchase, warehouse, or cost-peg transfer.

  • Translation Tables

    tcibd4504m000 Defines translation tables, which swap a value such as a year for a short code inside a generated number.

  • Update Indicative Item Value

    tcibd0201m200 Sets an item's indicative value, an estimated cost for planning, quoting and comparing, and not a costing figure.

  • Values by Translation Table

    tcibd4106m000 Holds the rows of a translation table, each value and the code that replaces it in a generated number.

  • Warehouse - Item Inventory

    whwmd2515m000 One row per warehouse holding or expecting an item — where a warehouse to ship from is chosen.

  • Warehouse Inspections Overview

    whinh3122m000 Where inbound and outbound inspections are viewed and maintained — the step that can hold a receipt.

  • Warehouse Manager Dashboard

    whinh2300m000 Management overviews of inbound and outbound warehousing orders.

  • Warehouse Receipt

    whinh3512m000 Creates and confirms receipts — where inbound goods become inventory.

  • Warehouses

    whwmd2500m000 Lists the warehouses defined for the current logistics company.

  • Warehousing Order

    whinh2100m100 The order that initiates and controls one inventory transaction in Warehousing, generated automatically or entered by hand.

  • Warehousing Order Types

    whinh0110m000 Holds the settings a warehousing order type gives its orders, among them its inventory transaction type and how its shipments and loads are built.

  • Warehousing Orders

    whinh2100m000 Lists warehousing orders — the starting point for almost every warehousing procedure.

  • Work Center

    tirou0101s000 One work center in detail, used where the Job Shop by Site concept is inactive.

  • Work Center

    tirou0601m000 One work center in detail, used where the Job Shop by Site concept is active.

  • Work Centers

    tirou0101m000 Lists work centres, used for cost estimating and planning — not a one-for-one model of the physical shop floor.

    tccom0100s000 Not documented yet.

    tiipd0601m000 Not documented yet.
